items.title: NEW — A65's ruling left open: `import pkg::a::b` where `a.vl` DECLARES an item `b` and `a/b.vl` also exists takes the FILE (longest module prefix wins, documented in `longest_module_prefix`), not an ambiguity error — unlike `a.vl` + `a/lib.vl`, which is one
items.discussion: lane a65's find (2026-09-08); OWNER Q — my recommendation: the ambiguity error, one rule for both collisions
items.status: OPEN — lane a65's find (2026-09-08); OWNER Q
items.body: Decide and pin: either the ambiguity error (recommended — a directory is the author's statement, but so is the item, and a silent winner is how a rename goes wrong) or the documented longest-prefix rule with a note in names.md §4.2.

items.title: NEW — a pure-namespace module entity (a directory with no body, A65) is attributed to `SourceId(0)` at `EMPTY_SPAN` because it names no file, so go-to-definition on such a segment lands at the ENTRY's top; hover and references on the segment have the same nowhere to point
items.discussion: lane a65's find (2026-09-08); harmless, not ideal
items.body: Give the namespace a location: the directory itself (a `file://` URI to the directory, or its first child's file at line 1), and answer go-to-definition, hover (the children it holds) and references from it; pin all three.

items.title: NEW — three notes from a65: `own` is a vilan keyword documented nowhere in the tour (cost a lane a debug cycle on a fixture); loading `pkg::lib::util` also loads `lib`'s body when it has one (Rust's model — a child import can pull a heavy parent), intended but unstated in the docs; build-hooks.md:1035's "a subdirectory cannot be imported today" is now false, so the generated root (kolt's `src/lucide`) may move under `root` as an ordinary module path — the build-hooks paper's follow-up
items.body: Two doc lines (the tour's keyword list; names.md's parent-body sentence) and one paper note; the generated-root move is its own decision on the build-hooks paper.
